label: Generic clinical history
note: Runs for any complaint with no authored flow. Slot order is the order the engine prefers to fill them, but it always skips slots the patient has already answered.

slots.about: when it started and how long it has been going on
slots.ask: When did it start, and how long has it been going on?

slots.about: where in the body the problem is, if it has a location
slots.ask: Where in your body is it?

slots.about: what it feels like in their own words
slots.ask: How would you describe what it feels like?

slots.about: how bad it is, out of ten, and whether it stops them doing things
slots.ask: How bad is it, out of ten — and is it stopping you doing things?

slots.about: whether it is getting better, worse, or staying the same
slots.ask: Is it getting better, getting worse, or staying about the same?

slots.about: any other symptoms that came with it, such as fever, vomiting, or weight loss
slots.ask: Has anything else come with it — fever, vomiting, weight loss, anything?

slots.about: whether it is worse at any particular time or in any position
slots.ask: Is it worse at any particular time, or in any position?

slots.about: what makes it better, and anything already tried
slots.ask: Does anything make it better? Have you tried anything for it?

background.ask: Are you taking any regular medicines?
Do you have any drug allergies?

background.about: any ongoing or past medical conditions
background.ask: Do you have any ongoing or past medical conditions?

background.about: whether they smoke now or used to, and roughly how much
background.ask: Do you smoke, or did you used to? Roughly how much?

background.about: whether they are or might be pregnant, if applicable
background.ask: Are you, or could you be, pregnant?
